name: AI Agents Map
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Your AI setup on one map: coding agents with plan, limits and usage, local LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Jan, KoboldCpp) and their models, MCP servers and skills. Setup installs, updates and signs in everything; connect by drawing a line, with preview and Undo. A red ! lists open problems, batteries show limits and free GPU memory, local LLMs get a stop button. New: Smart Check, where Claude Code or Codex checks your setup, finds updates and shows its tokens. 8 languages.
